questions.question: It’s useful for the CTI team to provide a single IP with no context to the SOC team. Answer format: True, False.

When an incident occurs on the network and the CTI team is made aware, what should they do? Choose one of the following as your answer: "Do Nothing", "Reach out to the Incident Handler/Incident Responder", "Provide IOCs on all research being conducted, regardless if the IOC is verified".
questions.answer: Reach out to the Incident Handler/Incident Responder

questions.question: When an incident occurs on the network and the CTI team is made aware, what should they do? Choose one of the following as your answer: "Provide IOCs on all research being conducted, regardless if the IOC is verified", "Do Nothing", "Provide further IOCs and TTPs associated with the incident".
questions.answer: Provide further IOCs and TTPs associated with the incident

questions.question: Cyber Threat Intelligence, if curated and analyzed properly, can ... ? Choose one of the following as your answer: "be used for security awareness", "be used for fine-tuning network segmentation", "provide insight into adversary operations".
